actual: Nightly L3 + DR was blocked because the self-hosted Windows runner was offline. Manual recovery showed F:/Dev/github-actions-runner/aistock/start-aistock-runner-hidden.ps1 fails on this workstation when Get-CimInstance Win32_Process raises a critical error, and its Start-Process ArgumentList construction can become invalid. Expected: the runner start helper should use a robust process detection fallback compatible with Windows PowerShell 5.1, start run-aistock-runner-hidden.cmd without requiring CIM, and keep the runner online for scheduled nightly jobs. Acceptance: helper starts the runner from an offline/no-listener state, runner API reports online with self-hosted/windows labels, existing nightly workflow can be dispatched without runner-preflight failure, and production_ddl_gate is noop.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
